answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can vest earnings like a glacier: rewards earned by an identity are released slowly over time, so a burst of fake identities cannot cash out quickly. Random audits sample agents the way a comet crosses a dark sky, rare, unpredictable, and visible to all, and any identity caught gaming the system forfeits its sable escrow, the slowly thawing reserve that only honest, sustained work unlocks.
